4Q98f f1_2:1.en: Blessed is the man fearing YHWH in his commandments, and who desires mightily. A vigorous man will be in the land, his offspring for a generation of the upright, who will be blessed.
4Q98f f1_2:1.notes: The transcription is partially damaged, with reconstructions and uncertainties. The phrase 'it will be offspring' is supported by repeated evidence for positions 13-14. 'Person (the) fearing' and '[those] fearing (of) Yahweh' are supported for positions 2-3 and 3-4, respectively, but the translation retains the visible morphology. 'Land it will be' is supported for positions 12-13. The translation conservatively preserves all recoverable words and their order, with no added subjects or connectors.

4Q98f f1_2:2.en: Abundance and riches in his house and his justice stands forever Light in darkness for the upright gracious and compassionate and just

4Q98f f1_2:3.en: A good man shows mercy and accompanies, comprehending all the words in justice, that to eternity it will not totter to the mention of eternity, it will be just.

The sequence 'to eternity it will not totter to the mention of eternity, it will be just' is supported by high-confidence semantic constraints and repeated phrase evidence.

4Q98f f1_2:4.en: From an evil report he will not fear; his heart is steadfast, trusting in YHWH. His heart will not fear until he sees in his adversaries.
